summary: Backend testing of FortexaRH P2 Native Fiscal Reports module (Colombia PILA UGPP + Mexico IMSS-SUA + INFONAVIT) and Global Compliance Center catalog. 21/21 tests PASSED. Validated: (1) GET /api/native-reports/catalog returns total_countries=28, total_formats=33, implemented_formats=7, with full country object shape (code/name/flag/region/currency/agency/social_security_system/formats/implemented_count/total_count/compliance_status); (2) DO entry has implemented_count=4, total_count=4, compliance_status=complete with codes {TSS_AUTODET,TSS_NOVEDADES,IR3,IR17}; (3) CO entry has implemented_count=1 with PILA; (4) MX entry has implemented_count=2 with IMSS_SUA + INFONAVIT; (5) the other 25 countries all have implemented_count=0 and compliance_status=universal_only; (6) Country guard: GET /co/pila, /mx/imss-cuotas, /mx/infonavit while company.country=DO each return 400 with detail mentioning the country mismatch; (7) After PUT /api/country-config/company/country?country_code=CO, GET /co/pila?period=2026-03 returns 200 text/plain, Content-Disposition starts with 'PILA_', body >100 bytes, header line starts with '1', detail records start with '2' and are exactly 942 chars (latin-1 encoding); (8) MX IMSS-SUA returns 200 text/plain with fixed-width records (>150 chars) and filename 'IMSS_SUA_Cuotas_'; (9) MX INFONAVIT returns 200 text/plain with filename 'INFONAVIT_'; (10) Empty-period (2099-12) returns 404 with 'No hay datos' message for all three formats; (11) Auth required (401/403) on catalog and pila when no token; (12) Regression iter_235: available-reports 200, cost-comparison 200, cost-comparison-pdf 200 application/pdf %PDF-, fiscal-summary 404 on no data — all PASS. CRITICAL CLEANUP: session-scoped fixture restored company.country to 'DO' at end of run; verified via GET /api/country-config/company → country_code=DO.
critical_code_review_comments: native_reports.py line 167: `_pad_str('X', 1) if False else _pad_str(' ', 1)` — dead code (the `if False` ternary). Should be replaced with a proper boolean (e.g. flag for 'extranjero no obligado'). Currently always produces a single space. Cosmetic but signals an unfinished branch.
DRY: MX IMSS and MX INFONAVIT share ~15 lines of header parsing (rfc/registro_patronal/nss/ap_paterno/ap_materno/sdi). Extract a `_mx_employee_common(emp, entry, company)` helper.

PILA detail record is built field-by-field then re-padded to 942 with `(line + ' '*942)[:942]`. The accumulated fields already have known widths; if any individual width is wrong the silent truncation/padding masks the bug. Consider `assert len(line) == 942` (or compute and log when mismatched) to surface spec drift early.

_collect_period_data is imported from multi_country_reports — good reuse. However the country guard runs a separate `db.companies.find_one` and then the body runs another one; merge into a single fetch to avoid 2 DB round-trips per request.

PILA Tarifa fields use `_pad_num(rate*100, 7, decimals=4)`. Verify with a CO accountant: UGPP spec typically uses 7 chars with 2 decimals (e.g. 0040000=4%) — current code produces 6-decimal magnitude after the *100 then *10^4 multiplier. Likely off by 100x. Functional bug for filing accuracy (file structurally valid but rates wrong). NOT blocking the structural tests but a HIGH priority correctness item before going live.

Catalog: compliance_status='complete' is assigned when impl_count == len(formats). For CO that means 1/1 → 'complete' (per request, the test treats this as partial OR complete to avoid coupling to either choice). Recommend an extra status like 'partial-spec' for countries where only one of multiple expected agencies is covered, or extend CO catalog to also list DIAN forms (e.g. Form 350) so the impl ratio reflects reality (1/2 → partial).

Filename uses RNC unsanitized into Content-Disposition. _clean_doc strips non-digits for nit but RFC for MX is upper()ed only — if a company stores 'XAXX-010101-000' the dashes will pass through. Strip non-alphanumerics for safety.
No tests present for malformed period (e.g. 'abc', '202603', empty). Endpoint does fall back to current month silently — could hide caller bugs.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Native Fiscal Reports backend is fully validated. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_native_reports.py contains 21 reusable tests across 6 classes (TestCatalog, TestCountryGuard, TestColombiaPILA, TestMexicoIMSS, TestNativeReportsAuth, TestRegressionIter235). The session-scoped autouse fixture `restore_country_to_do` GUARANTEES company.country is reset to 'DO' after the suite — verified post-run via /api/country-config/company. PILA file is 942-byte detail records (latin-1). MX files use latin-1 too. The 7 implemented formats are: 4 in DO (TSS_AUTODET/TSS_NOVEDADES/IR3/IR17) + 1 in CO (PILA) + 2 in MX (IMSS_SUA/INFONAVIT) = 7. Other 25 countries are universal_only stubs. If the main agent adds a new format, increment `implemented_formats` expected value in test_catalog_basic_shape. Helper `_set_country(client, code)` toggles the company country between tests via PUT /api/country-config/company/country?country_code=XX. The catalog endpoint is country-independent and does NOT require switching country.
